newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve kicked off the new year and the new maintenance period on Thursday by adding reserves to the U.S. banking system through a round of overnight system repurchase agreements, a New York Fed spokeswoman said.
The operation, which came at the Fed's new intervention time just after 1030 EST/1530 GMT, was expected, although analysts had anticipated a round of multi-day term system RPs.
Federal funds were firm at 5-11/16 percent when the Fed entered the open market, well above the 5-1/4 percent target rate.
